description_en: Queries the usage of auto-increment table IDs
description_zh: 调用GetAutoIncrementUsageStatistic接口，获取表自增ID的使用数据
kebab_example: aliyun das get-auto-increment-usage-statistic --instance-id rm-2ze8g2am976240000 --ratio-filter 0.9 --real-time false --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAutoIncrementUsageStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The database name. If you specify a database, the operation queries the usage of auto-increment table IDs in the specified database. Otherwise, the operation queries the usage of auto-increment table IDs in all databases on the instance.

Specify the parameter value as a JSON array, such as ['db1','db2']. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。传入此参数时，查询指定数据库中表自增ID使用情况，不传入时查询实例上所有数据库的表自增ID使用情况。
数据格式为JSONArray，例如['db1','db2']，数据库名间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en: The usage threshold of auto-increment IDs. Only usage that exceeds the threshold can be returned. Valid values are decimals that range from 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 自增ID使用比例过滤值，只返回超过该比例的自增ID使用数据。取值为0~1的小数
parameters.name: ratio_filter

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query real-time data. Valid values:

true: queries data in real time except for data generated in the last 10 minutes.\\

false: queries data generated in the last 2 hours. If no such data exists, queries the latest data
parameters.help_zh:
是否获取实时数据：

true：实时查询实例上数据并计算。最小查询时间粒度为10分钟，即有10分钟内的数据时，即使传递true也不进行实时查询。
false：当有近两小时的数据时，返回该数据，否则查询实例上最新数据
parameters.name: real_time

AutoIncrementUsageList.description_en: The usage details of auto-increment IDs

AutoIncrementRatio.description_en: The usage ratio of auto-increment IDs

MaximumValue.description_en: The maximum auto-increment ID that is supported by the current data type
MaximumValue.description_zh: 该数据类型的自增ID支持的最大值

ErrorInfo.description_en: The error message returned if the task fails
ErrorInfo.description_zh: 任务失败时的错误信息
ErrorInfo.example: the given database name list invalid, none of the database names in the list exist on the instance

Timestamp.description_zh: 执行时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒（ms）
